text:
CLASSIFICATION::protocol
Description
This command provides classification for the least explicit
application name. (Example: http, ssl)
Note: the Policy Enforcement Manager license is required for
functionality to work.
Syntax
CLASSIFICATION
::
protocol
Examples
when
CLASSIFICATION_DETECTED
{
if
{
[
CLASSIFICATION
::
protocol
]
==
"http"
}
{
drop
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
CLASSIFICATION_DETECTED
